column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 21, 24, 102, 110, 115,
120, 129, 133 and 139 of Block 03, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 520038, situated in the Village of Venivelkola within the Grama
Niladhari Division of No. 601 - Wenivelkola in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Homagama, in the District of Colombo, in the
Province of Western, referred to in Notice No. 52/0978 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No.
2079/23 of 10th July, 2018 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
